    exact Module.End.aeval_apply_of_mem_apply_eq_smul (f := h) (p := q) (h_T002 i).2
  have hkill (i : Ix l) (hij : i ≠ j) : q.eval (μ i) = 0 := by
    simp only [q, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_C]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr
      ⟨i, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ i⟩, sub_self _⟩
